text: Once the three 24000-step N=64 references exist (seeds 21 and 23 on data_seed 1, seed 22 on data_seed 0), does every same-layer, same-horizon N=64 minus N=128 force gap fall on the same side of 0.04 as its 12000-step value? Or do only seeds whose N=64 force had already levelled off by step 12000 keep a gap of at least 0.04?
